method.preplanned_basis: v20_plan.json fixed one existing-place target and required positive semantic subject-to-birthplace identifier plus typed geography, not fuzzy city matching.
method.chosen_provider: Published institutional lobid GND service chosen before any endpoint failure. Official service discovery identifies hbz and GND RDF/EntityFacts as its data basis; this is provider-level discovery, not proof that the target record contains any particular fact.
method.stopping_rule: Lobid route stopped after denial/inaccessible JSON. A subsequently authorized first inspection of original DNB base record also failed and stopped. No endpoint variants, rawGET, UA/proxy/auth changes or bot-protection bypass.
method.no_portal_source_assumption: The GND122880773 link was displayed in the earlier Deutsche Biographie profile. It is only an authority pointer until separately inspected; not assumed to be the supplier of that portal birthdate or birthplace.
method.no_independence_claim: Different presentations/providers of GND would be the same underlying authority work, not independent corroboration. None was successfully read here.
method.grade_role: Only potential future S3 geographic_support_only was planned. No new source grade assigned or adopted in this pilot.
method.no_negative_data_claim: Access failure establishes neither absence of placeOfBirth in GND nor an absent biography or wrong existing birthplace. No country/hemisphere inference or DOB verdict.
method.source_owner_fallback: One distinct original DNB base record was first opened after parent instruction and a timestamped adaptive intent, following the already displayed person authority URI. It was not a retry of the denied lobid service; no original DNB HTML/RDF alternate endpoint was attempted.
method.timing_amendment: The original source-owner fallback was planned after the provider failure and before that request; it is an adaptive source step, not retrospectively a source-blind preregistration.
